20261118-chemistry-g05.title: Kula manzi eswekile
20261118-chemistry-g05.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-Kula manzi eswekile ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261118-chemistry-g05.material: Iswekile eyi-50 g yafakwa kumanzi a-200 g yaza yanyibilika ngokupheleleyo. Kula manzi eswekile, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ye-“solvent”, “solute” ne-“solution”?
20261118-chemistry-g05.s.s1.prompt: Iswekile eyi-50 g yafakwa kumanzi a-200 g yaza yanyibilika ngokupheleleyo. Kula manzi eswekile, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ye-“solvent”, “solute” ne-“solution”?

20261118-chemistry-g05.s.s1.hint.0: Ulwelo olunyibilikisayo = solvent, into enyibilikayo = solute, umxube ogqityiweyo = solution.
20261118-chemistry-g05.s.s1.hint.1: Kwamanzi eswekile, iswekile enyibilikayo yisolute, amanzi anyibilikisayo yisolvent.

20261119-chemistry-g05.title: umxube ofanayo
20261119-chemistry-g05.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-umxube ofanayo ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261119-chemistry-g05.material: Sifuna ukuphanda iimpawu zesisombululo setyuwa esikwi-beaker. Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo yempawu yesisombululo, umxube ofanayo?
20261119-chemistry-g05.s.s1.prompt: Sifuna ukuphanda iimpawu zesisombululo setyuwa esikwi-beaker. Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo yempawu yesisombululo, umxube ofanayo?
20261119-chemistry-g05.s.s1.explain: Isisombululo esiyinyani (umxube ofanayo) sinamasuntswana esolute asasazeke ngokulinganayo phakathi kweemolekyuli zesolvent, ngoko nokuba sishiywe ixesha elide asityi aze ukuxinana kuyafana kuzo zonke iindawo.
20261119-chemistry-g05.s.s1.hint.0: Isisombululo ngumxube “ofanayo” oxutywe ngokulinganayo kwinqanaba leemolekyuli.
20261119-chemistry-g05.s.s1.o.o0: Nokuba uthatha isampulu kwindawo ephezulu, ephakathi okanye ephantsi yesisombululo, ubusi betyuwa (ukuxinana) buyafana ngokupheleleyo
20261119-chemistry-g05.s.s1.o.o1: Ixesha lingaphambili, ityuwa iyatshona ngokwayo ngenxa yobunzima
20261119-chemistry-g05.s.s1.o.o2: Ngokujonga ngeglasi yokukhulisa, amaqhekeza etyuwa abonakala ebhabha emanzini
20261119-chemistry-g05.s.s1.o.o3: Ngokuhluza ngephepha lokuhluza, yonke ityuwa ihluzwa kwiphepha

20261121-chemistry-g05-1.material: Xa kufakwa ityuwa kumanzi a-100 g, kutheni ityuwa inyibilika ngakumbi xa amanzi ekubushushu be-60℃ kuneyo ye-20℃?

20261122-chemistry-g05-1.material: [Ukwenziwa kweekristali okunzulu] Kwenziwa isisombululo esigcweleyo se-alum enyibilike kumanzi ashushu e-60℃ de kwayeka ukunyibilika, yaza intsontelo yeselika yaxhonywa kwesi sisombululo yaza yapholiswa kancinci kubushushu begumbi, yaza kwakhula iikristali ezintle ze-alum ezikhazimlayo ezifana namatye azizityebi kwintsontelo. 20261119-chemistry-g06.title: kwavela iibhabhulu ezininzi
20261119-chemistry-g06.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-kwavela iibhabhulu ezininzi ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261119-chemistry-g06.material: Xa kwatshiswa i-asidi ye-hydrochloric ehlanjululweyo okanye iviniga kumaqokobhe amaqanda okanye iqhekeza lemabhile (equlethe i-calcium carbonate), kwavela iibhabhulu ezininzi. Yintoni utshintsho olwenzekayo xa le gesi iqokelelwa idluliswe kumanzi ekalika?
20261119-chemistry-g06.s.s1.prompt: Xa kwatshiswa i-asidi ye-hydrochloric ehlanjululweyo okanye iviniga kumaqokobhe amaqanda okanye iqhekeza lemabhile (equlethe i-calcium carbonate), kwavela iibhabhulu ezininzi. Yintoni utshintsho olwenzekayo xa le gesi iqokelelwa idluliswe kumanzi ekalika?
20261119-chemistry-g06.s.s1.explain: Xa i-calcium carbonate ($\text{CaCO}_3$) isabela nge-asidi, kuvela igesi yekhabhon diokside ($\text{CO}_2$), ize ikhabhon diokside isabele namanzi ekalika ($\text{Ca(OH)}_2$) yenze ukuphuphuma kwe-calcium carbonate emhlophe nokwenza amanzi aluphuke.
20261119-chemistry-g06.s.s1.hint.0: Xa i-carbonate ne-asidi zisabela, kuvelisa igesi yekhabhon diokside (CO₂).
20261119-chemistry-g06.s.s1.hint.1: Xa i-CO₂ idluliswa emanzini ekalika, ivelisa i-calcium carbonate ephuphumayo emhlophe.
20261119-chemistry-g06.s.s1.o.o0: Amanzi ekalika ayaluphuka abe mhlophe (kuqinisekiswa igesi yekhabhon diokside)
20261119-chemistry-g06.s.s1.o.o1: Xa kufakwa umlilo emanzini ekalika, atsha ngesandi esikhulu
20261119-chemistry-g06.s.s1.o.o2: Umbala wamanzi ekalika uguquka ube luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka

20261121-chemistry-g06-1.title: ine-basicity) ngexesha lokupheka intlanzi
20261121-chemistry-g06-1.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-ine-basicity) ngexesha lokupheka intlanzi ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261121-chemistry-g06-1.material: Yintoni umgaqo wesayensi wobulumko bemihla ngemihla wokufafaza ijusi yelemon okanye iviniga ukususa ivumba lentlanzi (i-trimethylamine njl. ine-basicity) ngexesha lokupheka intlanzi?
20261121-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.prompt: Yintoni umgaqo wesayensi wobulumko bemihla ngemihla wokufafaza ijusi yelemon okanye iviniga ukususa ivumba lentlanzi (i-trimethylamine njl. ine-basicity) ngexesha lokupheka intlanzi?
20261121-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.explain: I-amines, ezizizinto ezibangela ivumba lentlanzi, zine-alkali, ngoko ukufafaza ijusi yelemon (i-citric acid) okanye iviniga (i-acetic acid) kubangela impendulo yokuthomalalisa phakathi kwe-asidi ne-base ize ivumba lentlanzi lisuswe.
20261121-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.hint.0: Xa i-asidi ne-base zidibana zilahlekelwa yimpawu zazo, kwenzeka “impendulo yokuthomalalisa”.

20261122-chemistry-g06-1.title: Ukuqiqa impendulo okunzulu
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-Ukuqiqa impendulo okunzulu ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.material: [Ukuqiqa impendulo okunzulu] Kwi-solution ye-sodium hydroxide eguqula iphepha le-litmus elibomvu laba luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, kwatshiswa kancinci i-hydrochloric acid ehlanjululweyo ngepipette ngokuxutywa. Yeyiphi inguquko echanekileyo kumxube xa kufakwe i-hydrochloric acid eyaneleyo?
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.prompt: [Ukuqiqa impendulo okunzulu] Kwi-solution ye-sodium hydroxide eguqula iphepha le-litmus elibomvu laba luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, kwatshiswa kancinci i-hydrochloric acid ehlanjululweyo ngepipette ngokuxutywa. Yeyiphi inguquko echanekileyo kumxube xa kufakwe i-hydrochloric acid eyaneleyo?
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.explain: Xa i-asidi (i-hydrochloric acid) ne-base (i-sodium hydroxide) zisabela, kuvela amanzi nelayi, ubushushu bokuthomalalisa buyakhutshwa ize ubushushu bunyuke. Xa i-hydrochloric acid ifakwe ngokugqithisileyo, isisombululo sonke siba nge-asidi siguqule iphepha le-litmus eliluhlaza libe bomvu.
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.hint.0: Kwimpendulo yokuthomalalisa, ubushushu bokuthomalalisa buyavela kwaye ubushushu buyanda.
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.hint.1: Xa i-hydrochloric acid ifakwe ngokugqithisileyo, kuba sisisombululo se-asidi.
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.o.o0: Ubushushu buyavela kwaye buyanda, ize isisombululo sokugqibela siguqule iphepha le-litmus eliluhlaza lube bomvu
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.o.o1: Isisombululo siphola ngokukhawuleza siguquke sibe ngumkhenkce
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.o.o2: Akukho mpendulo yenzekayo kwaye ihlala injalo
